title: "My kid spilled coffee and I didn't murder her, so I'm a great mom"
caption:
A viral "gentle parenting" video gets picked apart on Is Lindsay Clancy Guilty or a Victim of Psychosis? — the whole thesis is she didn't hurt her daughter, so she's a hero mom. Then comes the question nobody asked: why was the camera already rolling?
